title: Understanding Steem's Dual-Token Economy
body: Steem operates with a unique dual-token system that powers its blockchain ecosystem. The native STEEM token serves as both a governance asset and a means of exchange, while Steem Dollars (SBD) provide a stable unit of account. This structure creates interesting economic dynamics within the platform. SBD was originally designed to maintain a 1:1 peg with the US dollar, though market conditions can cause deviations. Understanding how these two tokens interact is fundamental to grasping Steem's economic model. The blockchain's inflation mechanism distributes new tokens to content creators and curators, with a portion allocated to the SBD savings pool to maintain stability. This system rewards active participation while aiming to provide a stable medium for transactions and rewards.
